brief.zh: 这次巡查只看达到严格门槛的预测。调整置信度前后，核对照片和候选清单。
brief.en: This inspection uses a strict threshold. Compare the photo and the detections before and after raising it.

concept.zh: 门槛足够高时，候选清单可以变为空。
concept.en: A high enough threshold can leave the candidate list empty.

hints.zh: 保留“全部类别”。先读出默认分数，再把门槛调到它上面。
hints.en: Keep All classes. Read the default score, then raise the threshold above it.

prompt.zh: 保持“全部类别”，只调置信度，让显示的候选框变为 0 个。
prompt.en: Keep All classes and adjust only confidence until zero boxes remain visible.
